arxiv-1704-00568.title: A parametric level-set method for partially discrete tomography
arxiv-1704-00568.creator: Ajinkya Kadu, Tristan van Leeuwen, K. Joost Batenburg
arxiv-1704-00568.description: Abstract This paper introduces a parametric level-set method for tomographic reconstruction of partially discrete images. Such images consist of a continuously varying background and an anomaly with a constant (known) grey-value. We represent the geometry of the anomaly using a level-set function, which we represent using radial basis functions.

arxiv-2305-13766.title: From multivalued to Boolean functions: preservation of soft nested canalization
arxiv-2305-13766.creator: Élisabeth Remy, Paul Ruet
arxiv-2305-13766.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Élisabeth Remy, Paul Ruet. Nested canalization (NC) is a property of Boolean functions which has been recently extended to multivalued functions. We study the effect of the Van Ham mapping (from multivalued to Boolean functions) on this property. We introduce the class of softly nested canalizing (SNC) multivalued functions, and prove that the Van Ham mapping sends SNC multivalued functions to NC Boolean functions. Since NC multivalued functions are SNC, this preservation property holds for NC multivalued functions as well.

arxiv-2511-23283.description: Abstract . Nondeterminism makes parallel programs challenging to write and reason about. To avoid these challenges, researchers have developed techniques for internally deterministic parallel programming, in which the steps of a parallel computation proceed in a deterministic way. Internal determinism is useful because it lets a programmer reason about a program as if it executed in a sequential order.

pmc-10518924.title: Predicting the drop out from the maternal, newborn and child healthcare continuum in three East African Community countries: application of machine learning models
pmc-10518924.creator: Chenai Mlandu, Zvifadzo Matsena-Zingoni, Eustasius Musenge
pmc-10518924.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundFor optimal health, the maternal, newborn, and child healthcare (MNCH) continuum necessitates that the mother/child receive the full package of antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care. In sub-Saharan Africa, dropping out from the MNCH continuum remains a challenge. Using machine learning, the study sought to forecast the MNCH continuum drop out and determine important predictors in three East African Community (EAC) countries.MethodsThe study utilised Demographic Health Surveys data from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) (2013/14), Kenya (2014) and Tanzania (2015/16).

pmc-10867950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PurposeIleocolonoscopy aids in the diagnosis of ileocecal region pathologies when typical mucosal lesions are seen.
